about_the_game:
Surge Point is a fast-paced, single-player FPS roguelike with deep weapon customization and high-mobility combat. Inspired by classics like DOOM and Quake, it drops you into a simulated arena full of deadly robotic enemies. Build your own weapon, master the movement system, and survive wave after wave — or fight through hand-crafted levels in mission mode.

⚙️ Modular Weapons, Built Your Way

There are no pre-made guns — just the base gun body and parts. Find components during your run and snap them together to build your perfect weapon:

  • Barrels, mags, stocks, sights, and grips that affect fire rate, accuracy, damage, reload time, bullet velocity, and more

  • Special ammo types like explosive, bouncing, or tracer rounds

  • Real-time swapping lets you customize on the fly, adapting to each challenge

🕹️ Fast, Fluid Movement

Combat isn't just about shooting — it's about speed and style.
Surge Point features a movement system that rewards creativity:

  • Classic FPS movement (run, jump, strafe) with a modern feel

  • Gun recoil propels you in the opposite direction — use it to dodge or launch yourself through the air

  • Deployable holo cubes let you create platforms to jump off or gain the high ground

🎯 Two Ways to Play

  • Endless Mode: Battle randomized waves of enemies in procedurally generated arenas, testing how far your skill and weapon crafting can take you.

  • Mission Mode: Fight through linear, hand-crafted levels with clear objectives and structured progression.

🧾 Early Access Roadmap

Surge Point is in Early Access and under active development.
Here’s what’s available right now:

  • Modular weapon system with part-swapping

  • 3 enemy types

  • Endless survival mode

  • Mission mode with hand-crafted levels

  • Procedural map generation

  • Gamepad and keyboard/mouse support

Coming in future updates:

  • More missions with unique objectives and layouts

  • More enemy types and attack patterns

  • New map tiles and visual themes

  • Additional weapon parts and effects

  • Mini-boss or boss enemies that appear after X waves

  • Missions to complete for rewards

  • A separate mode focused on platforming (using gun recoil and holo cubes)

  • More environmental interaction (destructibles, interactables, etc.)

  • Fixed mode using the same seed for everyone, with leaderboard support

  • Keybinding and controller remapping

content_descriptors.notes: Surge Point contains frequent, stylized violence against robotic enemies. Combat includes gunfire, explosions, and fast-paced action, but there is no blood, gore, or dismemberment. The game does not contain sexual content, strong language, depictions of drug or alcohol use, or any narrative themes involving abuse or self-harm.
